description: This file defines interfaces for device information, audio capabilities, and video capabilities within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace. It includes virtual classes with methods to retrieve device properties and supported features.

classes.name: IDeviceInfo
classes.description: Interface for retrieving device identification details such as serial number, SKU, make, model, device type, SOC name, distributor ID, brand, release version, and chipset.

classes.name: IDeviceAudioCapabilities
classes.description: Interface for querying audio output ports, capabilities, MS12 capabilities, and supported MS12 audio profiles.

classes.name: IDeviceVideoCapabilities
classes.description: Interface for querying supported video displays, default resolution, supported resolutions, host EDID, and HDCP support.

methods.name: AudioCapabilities
methods.description: Gets audio capabilities for a specified audio port.

methods.name: MS12Capabilities
methods.description: Gets MS12 capabilities for a specified audio port.

methods.name: SupportedMS12AudioProfiles
methods.description: Gets supported MS12 audio profiles for a specified audio port.

methods.name: DefaultResolution
methods.description: Gets the default resolution for a given video display.

methods.name: SupportedResolutions
methods.description: Gets supported resolutions for a given video display.

methods.name: SupportedHdcp
methods.description: Checks supported HDCP version for a given video display.
